keyPoints: Jeevan ko chalaye rakhne ke liye chaar mukhya prakriyayein hain — poshan (bhojan), shwasan (urja), parivahan (dhulai) aur utsarjan (safai).
Manav me bhojan ka pachan muh se shuru hokar chhoti aant me poora hota hai; yahaan ungli-numa ankuran (villi) poshak tatva sokhkar khoon me milate hain.
Fefdon (lungs) me vayu-kosh (alveoli) gas ka aadan-pradan karte hain — oxygen khoon me jaati hai aur carbon dioxide bahar nikalti hai.
Hriday chaar kakshon wala dohri parivahan pump hai jo shuddh aur ashuddh rakt ko milne nahi deta; isse angon ko zyada oxygen milti hai.
Gurde rakt ko chhankar mootra banate hain; nephron iski ikai hai jahan chhanan, punah avashoshan aur sraavan teen charanon me hota hai.
Paudhon me xylem jal-khanij upar le jaata hai, phloem bhojan baant ta hai aur vaashpotsarjan (transpiration) paani ke upar chadhne me madad karta hai.
Aam galti: shwasan ko sirf saans lena samajhna; shwasan koshika ke andar bhojan se urja mukta karne ki prakriya hai, saans lena uska pehla kadam hai.
